answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted endorsement: each agent locks a refundable deposit before transacting, and its standing grows only through a trellis of endorsements from long-lived agents who risk their own deposits. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge of low trust, limited to small trades, and must climb by completing real work. A velvet-smooth reputation cannot be bought: forging many trustworthy histories costs more than one fraud earns.
